replies.body:
Heeya jeosprite,

I understand your frustration and I would probably do the same, yet I want to redirect you to the support email: support@avicus.net since this is not the right section to report a staff member. The moderator you reported could see this and try to remove evidence etc.
The support email is maintained by the senior moderators so don't be afraid to speak out your mind.
In order to prevent you from attacks, I'll remove the text you wrote in your original post. The senior moderators are still able to see it. (you have 5 mins to copy your text in order to send it to the email I linked).

Regards Flo/resepignev
